items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 57:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the externality of the NHY of Ima? It was explained above in Answer 9 that there is no difference whatsoever in the exit of the Mochin from their source in Aba and Ima, for they are always in the stature of the revealed AB, which comes out upon the MAN of the Mazalot, and even the Mochin of the first pregnancy of ZA is equal in this to the Mochin of the Yechida of ZA. And all the difference is only in the states of the pregnancy, and likewise in the measure of the coupling of Aba and Ima, from whichever Partzuf they bestow to him. See there. And it is found that the aspect of the pregnancy of the externality, he receives from the aspect of the NHY of the externality of Ima, from the aspect of her Partzuf of pregnancy; and likewise the aspect of the suckling of the externality of ZA, he receives from the NHY of the suckling of the externality of Ima; and the aspect of the Mochin of the externality, which are the Mochin of VAK, he receives from the NHY of the internality of the externality of Ima, namely from the aspect of her Mochin of VAK. And in this she completes for him the Aba and Ima of the externality. And in the same way she bestows to him the Aba and Ima of the internality of ZA, from the three aspects of the NHY of the Aba and Ima of her three inner Partzufim. (Item 185, and 186 and 187).
